pictures.author: Bahnfrend
pictures.observed: Close southwest corner: tall pale concrete frame and deep rectangular piers, full-height recessed greenish glazing/mullions, continuous broad upper beam, paved colonnade and an end-bay vertical grille. No copied posters or furnishings.

pictures.author: Bahnfrend
pictures.observed: Car-park exterior from east/northeast: off-centre tall glass entrance below a recessed notch in the upper concrete fascia; repeated rectangular frames and broad level paved forecourt. Camera and247.5degree bearing corroborate the+X entrance face.

pictures.author: Andrew Shiva / Wikipedia (Godot13)
pictures.observed: Previously viewed annotated aerial identifies the independent square Visitors Centre and its dark regular roof-panel grid. Main museum prism, memorial hall, roads and landscape remain separate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Visitors Centre, Yad Vashem: mapped square pale-concrete frame with six reconstructed bays per side, deep open perimeter colonnades, tall recessed mullioned glass, a car-park entrance below a notch in the upper fascia, low-frequency roof-panel grid and selected end-bay louvres. All four LODs keep the frame, recesses and roof notch. Interior visitor facilities, signs/photographic posters, benches, visitors, cars, trees and independent campus buildings remain context.
